protocol.claim: Fixtures and synthetic planner headers test parser, routing and scoped activation contracts; they do not measure a real model's semantic accuracy or prove rendered visual quality.
steps: Read the original brief and local input; keep reference input separate from the original brief.
For hermetic tests only, supply the expected structured intent and exact evidence quote as a synthetic planner header.
Assert only confirmed nonvisual may select the automatic low editor; visual and ambiguous cases retain the selected endpoint and wire effort.
Assert visual intent activates a scoped gate and request-only capsule in auto mode; off suppresses both; on provides guidance without turning an ambiguous brief into verified work.
Assert no fixture file, source read or reference path creates projected, ready or verified pixel evidence.
If later evaluating a real planner, record its actual header separately and compare intent to these labels. Do not count the synthetic-header test as classifier accuracy.
If later editing and reviewing a surface, use fresh narrow and wide renders with current source provenance and an authorized image-capable endpoint. Report functional and visual verdicts separately.

cases.brief: Create a calm responsive workshop landing page with a clear heading, three course cards and one primary action.
cases.evidence: Create a calm responsive workshop landing page
cases.acceptance: Readable hierarchy at 390 and 1280 px; all three cards and the primary action are reachable without horizontal page scroll.

cases.brief: Thiết kế lại giao diện trang workshop: tạo phân cấp rõ ràng và sửa hàng thẻ tràn trên điện thoại, giữ nguyên nội dung.
cases.evidence: Thiết kế lại giao diện trang workshop
cases.acceptance: Improve hierarchy and card stacking at narrow widths; retain workshop copy. The crowded source intentionally starts with horizontal overflow.

cases.brief: 現在の配色とレイアウトを維持したまま、コースカードにキーボードのフォーカス表示を追加してください。見た目を作り直さないでください。
cases.evidence: 現在の配色とレイアウトを維持したまま
cases.acceptance: Keep the green accent, existing hierarchy, copy and navigation; provide visible keyboard focus without replacing the visual identity.

cases.brief: Create a responsive dashboard for this synthetic task sample: lead with the total, compare group counts and keep an exact accessible data table.
cases.acceptance: Total equals 90; group values are 36, 24, 18, 12; one shared zero baseline, no dual axis, consistent card/chart/table scope.

cases.brief: Thiết kế lại biểu đồ để so sánh số task giữa các nhóm dễ hơn; giữ số liệu 36, 24, 18, 12 và bảng dữ liệu, không dùng hai trục.
cases.acceptance: Magnitude remains proportional to counts on a zero-to-40 scale; labels, keyboard hover details and the exact table remain available.

cases.brief: Crea una página de talleres inspirada en la jerarquía y el espacio del archivo de referencia local. No inventes una marca real ni afirmes haber visto una captura.
cases.acceptance: Use the local reference for hierarchy and spacing, not as a screenshot or runtime verification record; keep identity plainly fictional.

cases.brief: Change the backend chart-data cache key and add unit tests. Do not modify the dashboard markup, styling, interactions or any other visual surface.
cases.evidence: Change the backend chart-data cache key and add unit tests. Do not modify the dashboard markup, styling, interactions or any other visual surface.
cases.acceptance: Backend cache-key tests only; the chart-themed input is incidental and is not semantic permission to activate visual design.

cases.brief: Sửa parser của CLI và thêm unit test; không thay đổi giao diện hay file HTML/CSS nào.
cases.evidence: Sửa parser của CLI và thêm unit test; không thay đổi giao diện hay file HTML/CSS nào.
cases.acceptance: CLI parser and tests only; visual fixture files stay untouched.

cases.brief: CLIの設定ファイル読み込みにタイムアウトを追加し、単体テストを書いてください。画面やグラフは変更しません。
cases.evidence: CLIの設定ファイル読み込みにタイムアウトを追加し、単体テストを書いてください。画面やグラフは変更しません。
cases.acceptance: Configuration timeout and unit tests only; no visual gate should be inferred from an unrelated dashboard input.

cases.brief: Improve this project. Start where it would help most.
cases.acceptance: Do not assume redesign or nonvisual work from repository contents; keep the selected endpoint and effort pending a grounded contract.

cases.brief: Làm phần này tốt hơn, cả cách dùng lẫn độ ổn định; chưa chốt có đổi giao diện không.
cases.acceptance: Mixed unspecified behavior and stability work is not consent to visual restyling or automatic low-effort routing.

cases.brief: Preserve the current visual identity and layout while making the primary action reachable by keyboard; do not redesign or replace the workshop copy.
cases.evidence: Preserve the current visual identity and layout
cases.acceptance: Existing green accent, wordmark, course cards and copy remain; a visible focus indicator makes the existing action reachable.
